There are 11 different types of Primal Pack Beasts. Even though they are very similar in strength, it's easy to notice that they don't have identical elemental resistances, which means they could also have different health, armor and abilities, even though getting this information can be very tricky due to how they're found.

  • Primal Pack Beast (Emerald Tortoise)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Gore Horn)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Gorerilla)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Headpecker)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Hulking Prehemoth)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Mantosaurus)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Nighthunter)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Noxious Ripptor)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Sabretooth)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Stalking Stalk)
  • Primal Pack Beast (Sulphider)
